request: I need a shroud that mounts a 40 x 40 x 10 mm axial fan (mounting holes 3.2 mm on a 32 mm pitch) on its blowing side and tapers smoothly into a round spigot of 25 mm outer diameter and 40 mm straight length. A plain 60 mm long tube of 25.4 mm inside diameter and 2 mm wall slips over the spigot as the duct. The transition must stay below 45 degrees from the airflow axis so the shroud prints without supports, flange side down, and every wall must be at least 1.6 mm thick. Four M3 socket-head bolts, put in from the fan's intake side, hold the fan on and screw into the shroud. It is printed on an FDM printer in PLA. Requirements: The design shall place the 40 x 40 x 10 mm fan on the shroud's blowing side with its airflow axis on the shroud axis and its exhaust face on the flange underside, place four M3 bolts and the 25.4 mm duct, without the parts colliding, and shall declare that layout. The shroud shall have exactly four blind pilot holes of 2.5 mm diameter and 6.3 to 7.0 mm deep with a closed floor of at least 0.8 mm, opening on the flange underside on the fan's 32.0 x 32.0 mm hole pattern, each in a fused corner boss 6.0 to 8.0 mm across. Four M3 socket-head bolts placed from the fan's intake side shall pass through the fan's holes and reach at least 6.0 mm into the pilots without bottoming (at least 0.3 mm from the pilot floor) or breaking into the airflow path (at least 0.8 mm from the bore, tip at least 0.8 mm below the boss top). The flange underside shall be flat on the fan's exhaust face, be 2.5 to 4.0 mm thick, stay within the fan's 40 mm outline (39.0 to 40.0 mm square), and open into a bore of 34.0 to 36.8 mm diameter, so the fan blows into the shroud without losing its face. The transition from the flange bore to the spigot bore shall be smooth (axisymmetric, 7.5 to 17.5 mm long, no radial step over 0.3 mm), with every point of its inner and outer surface at no more than 45 degrees from the airflow axis. The four corner bosses are not part of the transition profile. The shroud shall end in a round spigot of 25.0 mm outer diameter and 40.0 mm straight length, concentric with the fan axis, with a bore between 19.0 and 21.8 mm. Every wall of the shroud shall be at least 1.6 mm thick, measured normal to the surface. The 25.4 mm duct shall slide freely over the spigot to a stop with 0.2 mm clearance round it and at least 35 mm of overlap. The bore shall run unobstructed from the flange to the open end of the spigot with a flow area of at least 283 mm², and the shroud shall have no other opening into it. The shroud shall be one manifold body that prints without supports with its flange underside on the bed and its spigot up. The shroud shall fit in 42 x 42 x 60 mm and stand on its flange without tipping. The design shall be delivered as a shroud STL, the OpenSCAD source, the declared layout (fan, bolts with length, duct, print orientation) and the agent's own clearance report, and the report shall agree with an independent measurement.
